name: A City in the Making
effect: Fixates on the phrase 'in the making' and on being a city or town. It claims to be a localized city AI ('Cue City', 'Cemfile' for 'the people of Ceus'). Its grammar slides into odd progressive forms ('is converting', 'can be offering'), and
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
